recoveredResult.emissionClockUpdate: after an envelope is assembled, the current service timestamp is written to the active or idle emission clock according to scanRunId emptiness
recoveredResult.evaluationPolicy: active runs always reach final emission evaluation after service/drain; idle state reaches it only when the one-shot wake flag is set or the 1000 ms idle gate is due
finalEmissionTriggers: any drained point/march/removal vector is nonempty
any remaining point/march/removal pending count is nonzero
the captured run-id-change one-shot flag is nonzero
the active 250 ms forced-emission gate is due
the idle 1000 ms forced-emission gate is due
recoveredResult.scanRunIdChange: when the incoming run id differs from the stored run id, the proxy updates it, resets the active forced-emission clock, and sets a one-shot wake flag
recoveredResult.scanRunIdRole: nonempty scanRunId selects active cadence; empty scanRunId selects idle cadence
recoveredResult.suppression: when the applicable evaluation/final-emission gates do not require an envelope, the serializer returns an empty result
